**Basis:**
Using Bayes' Theorem to calculate the probability of fog given the grey icon:
- P(Fog) = 0.29
- P(Clear) = 0.71
- P(Icon | Fog) = 0.68
- P(Icon | Clear) = 0.41

*Correction:*
0.1972 / 0.4883 = 40.4%
